description: This file contains the definition of the ShippingAddress class in the Opencart system, responsible for handling checkout shipping address functionalities such as viewing, saving, and managing shipping addresses during checkout.

classes.name: ShippingAddress
classes.description: Represents the checkout shipping address controller, managing the display and storage of shipping address data during the checkout process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping address form, initializing necessary data from session and configuration, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of shipping address data submitted from the checkout form, including validation, address creation, and session updates.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Provides the address details for a specified address ID, validating cart, session, and existing addresses, and returning appropriate JSON responses.
